title: Member Services Desk Manual, E.24 — A Member Closing a Refined Fuels and Propane Account
content:
A member closes an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts of their own accord whatever stands on it, and the balance the account closes at is written onto the account as what is owed and follows the member rather than being extinguished. Closing puts the account out of service for good: its standing moves to closed, the day it is closed is recorded against it, the balance it closes at is written onto it as what is owed, and the gallons still owed to the member out of a pre-buy are set to none. No further fuel is delivered on the account and no further charge is raised on it.

The balance the account closes at is fixed only after the account carries, for every signed pre-buy request the energy desk holds registered against it, the money applied against a booking when gallons standing undrawn were released.

## Closing the account

The account is closed with `close_energy_account_7515982f`. It is the member's own account and the member's own decision, so the desk unlocks the tool and hands it over for the customer themselves to run rather than running it for them.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `energy_account_id` | The internal reference number identifying the member's refined fuels or propane account being closed, as the desk reads it back from the energy account lookup |
| `account_number` | The account number printed on the member's delivery tickets and statements, written as EA- followed by six digits, for example EA-512044, as it appears on the statement. No other form is accepted and it is never left empty |
| `closing_balance_usd` | The balance the account closes at, in USD to 2 decimal places, passed as a decimal number, rounded half to even to 2 decimal places on the way in, and written onto the account as what is owed on it |

### What comes back

A confirmation sentence naming the account number closed, the date it closed as YYYY-MM-DD and the balance it closed at in USD to 2 decimal places. Receiving that sentence is what indicates the account now stands closed.

### Contract questions

**What happens to gallons still owed to the member out of a pre-buy?** The call sets them to none on the account.

**Is anything further billed on the account afterwards?** No. No further fuel is delivered on it and no further charge is raised on it.
